SPIRELAB-ATLAS_SURGE.description: Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold]. Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Add [gold]Falling Grit[/gold] to your Discard Pile.

SPIRELAB-STARTER_DRAUGHT.title: Starter Draught
SPIRELAB-POTION_TOSS.title: Potion Toss
SPIRELAB-POTION_TOSS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you gained extra Energy this turn, deal {Bonus:diff()} additional damage.
SPIRELAB-POTION_MIST.title: Potion Mist
SPIRELAB-SILVER_SCREEN.title: Silver Screen
SPIRELAB-RAZOR_PAGES.title: Razor Pages
SPIRELAB-RAZOR_PAGES.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you used Enlightenment this turn, deal {Bonus:diff()} additional damage.
SPIRELAB-BLACK_VEIL.title: Black Veil
SPIRELAB-BLACK_VEIL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If this is the first card played this turn, gain {Bonus:diff()} additional Block.
SPIRELAB-PINNACLE_OF_MANA.title: Pinnacle of Mana
SPIRELAB-PINNACLE_OF_MANA.description: For this combat, keep all unspent Energy when your turn ends.
SPIRELAB-THE_MIRROR_SELF.title: The Mirror Self
SPIRELAB-THE_MIRROR_SELF.description: On the first play each combat, set effective HP to max(1, Max HP − real HP). Gains become temporary mirror HP. Reflect 50% of blocked enemy attack damage, rounded down.
SPIRELAB-PRIMAL_GREED.title: Primal Greed
SPIRELAB-PRIMAL_GREED.description: [gold]Desire[/gold]. Shuffle the rest of your hand into your draw pile. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SPIRELAB-SLOTH.title: Sloth
SPIRELAB-SLOTH.description: [gold]Desire[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If this is the first card played this turn, instead prevent the next enemy attack before your next turn. End your turn.
SPIRELAB-FALLEN_CONFIDENCE.title: Fallen Confidence
SPIRELAB-FALLEN_CONFIDENCE.description: [gold]Desire[/gold]. For this combat, Desire cards cost 1 less Energy. Does not stack.
SPIRELAB-SOURCE_OF_CALAMITY.title: Source of Calamity
SPIRELAB-SOURCE_OF_CALAMITY.description: [gold]Desire[/gold]. Choose 1 of {Options:diff()} distinct random other Desire cards to add to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
SPIRELAB-ABYSS_OF_GAMBLING.title: Abyss of Gambling
SPIRELAB-ABYSS_OF_GAMBLING.description: [gold]Desire[/gold]. Lose {Percent:diff()}% of your current real HP, rounded up. Unplayable if this would leave you below 1 real HP. Draw {Cards:diff()}, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, and return this card to your hand.
